clips.expected: A butterfly left a tiny egg on a leaf. Shall we take a closer look? There is a little life growing inside. Let's be gentle and give it time.
clips.transcribed: A butterfly left a tiny egg on a leaf. Shall we take a closer look? There is a little life growing inside. Let's be gentle and give it time.

clips.expected: Zoey leans in. Did you see that tiny wiggle? The baby caterpillar is growing inside its egg.
clips.transcribed: Zoe leans in. Did you see that tiny wiggle? The baby caterpillar is growing inside its egg.

clips.expected: Crack! A little line appears in the shell. The caterpillar is ready to hatch. Watch the shell open.
clips.transcribed: Crack! A little line appears in the shell. The caterpillar is ready to hatch. Watch the shell open.

clips.expected: Hello, little caterpillar! It crawls out of its egg. Zoey waves hello. Our new friend is ready for some tasty leaves.
clips.transcribed: Hello, little caterpillar. It crawls out of its egg. Zoe waves hello. Our new friend is ready for some tasty leaves.

clips.expected: Zoey picks a leaf. Our little caterpillar is hungry! Caterpillars eat leaves and shed their old skin as they grow.
clips.transcribed: Zoe picks a leaf. Our little caterpillar is hungry. Caterpillars eat leaves and shed their old skin as they grow.

clips.expected: Crunch! Zoey offers the first leaf. What a lovely lunch. The caterpillar takes a bite and grows a little bigger.
clips.transcribed: Crunch! Zoe offers the first leaf. What a lovely lunch! The caterpillar takes a bite and grows a little bigger.

clips.expected: Crunch, crunch! Another leaf, another little growth spurt. Zoey reaches out carefully. Growing takes lots of energy.
clips.transcribed: Crunch! Crunch! Another leaf, another little growth spurt. Zoe reaches out carefully. Growing takes lots of energy.

clips.expected: Our caterpillar is all grown. It finds a safe branch. Watch it hang in a J shape and shed its skin to reveal a chrysalis.
clips.transcribed: Our caterpillar is all grown. It finds a safe branch. Watch it hang in a J shape and shed its skin to reveal a chrysalis.

clips.expected: A chrysalis hangs from the branch. Zoey waits quietly and watches. Inside, the caterpillar is changing into a butterfly.
clips.transcribed: A chrysalis hangs from the branch. Zoe waits quietly and watches. Inside, the caterpillar is changing into a butterfly.

clips.expected: The garden is quiet. The chrysalis gently sways. Days pass in nature. Our little story makes time move faster.
clips.transcribed: The garden is quiet. The chrysalis gently sways. Days pass in nature. Our little story makes time move faster.

clips.expected: Look, Zoey! The chrysalis shell is beginning to split. A butterfly will emerge with soft, folded wings.
clips.transcribed: Look, Zoe! The chrysalis shell is beginning to split. A butterfly will emerge with soft folded wings.

clips.expected: The butterfly climbs out, slowly and carefully. It holds on while its soft wings begin to unfurl.
clips.transcribed: The butterfly climbs out, slowly and carefully. It holds on while its soft wings begin to unfurl.

clips.expected: Zoey watches the butterfly rest on the branch. Its wings are soft and folded. Give them time to expand.
clips.transcribed: Zoe watches the butterfly rest on the branch. Its wings are soft and folded. Give them time to expand.

clips.expected: The wings slowly open. Look at those lovely colors! Zoey stretches too. The butterfly still needs time to dry its wings.
clips.transcribed: The wings slowly open. Look at those lovely colors. Zoe stretches too. The butterfly still needs time to dry its wings.

clips.expected: The wings are open and dry. A new adventure is waiting. Zoey lifts a hand. Are you ready to help our friend take flight?
clips.transcribed: The wings are open and dry. A new adventure is waiting. Zoe lifts a hand. Are you ready to help our friend take flight?

clips.expected: Up, up, and away! Zoey waves as the butterfly takes flight. Tap a flower to invite it for nectar. A butterfly can lay eggs, and the story begins again.
clips.transcribed: Up, up and away. Zoe waves as the butterfly takes flight. Tap a flower to invite it for nectar. A butterfly can lay eggs, and the story begins again.
